Premium.layout: Full-width Luxury Showcase with gold conic glow, feature pill tabs, comparison highlights, and exclusive VIP badge preview
Premium.enhancements: Golden border sweep, gold drop-shadow CTA button, 4K quality comparison badge, exclusive perk checklist with golden check icons.

Screens.layout: Interactive horizontal screen showcase gallery with device frames and screen selector pills
Screens.enhancements: Active phone screen frame switch animation, high-def image zoom preview modal trigger, subtle reflection sheen.

HowItWorks.layout: 3-Step sticky scroll storytelling with progress timeline beam on the left and active step preview card on the right
HowItWorks.enhancements: Numbered step nodes with glowing connections, step active state illumination, clean callout cards.

CreatorHub.layout: Split showcase layout with high-impact creator earnings highlight (85% payout) + feature list and creator registration CTA

Safety.enhancements: Lock/Shield animated icons, subtle emerald and purple security badge accents, clean card hover rise.

Roadmap.layout: Quarterly milestone card pipeline (Q1-Q4) with live status tags (Completed / In Progress / Upcoming)
Roadmap.enhancements: Connected timeline thread, glowing milestone status badges, progress indicators.

FAQ.layout: Dual-column accordion grid with smooth expand/collapse framer-motion transitions
FAQ.enhancements: Custom chevron rotation, glass panel expansion, highlight on open items.

FinalCTA.layout: High-conversion banner with central kinetic headline, dual APK download buttons, and age verification tag
FinalCTA.enhancements: Conic neon purple background aurora, glowing button pulse, age gate 18+ badge reaffirmation.

Footer.layout: Multi-column dark footer with brand bio, quick navigation links, legal compliance disclaimers, and copyright
Footer.enhancements: Massive background Velora typography watermark, discrete age warning badge, social icon hover highlights.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never make generic centered flat cards with standard borders. Use varied grids, spotlights, and depth gradients.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='download-apk-button').
Header must ALWAYS have a semi-opaque background with blur (bg-[#08050D]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl) to avoid unreadable overlays.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or fixed navigation bars.
Use Syne font for headlines, Plus Jakarta Sans for body text, JetBrains Mono for stats and badges.
Keep all JS file formats (.jsx / .js) intact without TypeScript syntax errors.
Support full bilingual ES/EN language switching smoothly across all sections.
